=== Day 3: the town meeting ===
Hollis: "So that the record is free of ambiguity on this point: I am the Gravedigger."
Hollis: "Last night, I learned that Greta, whom we hanged, was the Poisoner."  [case board: #89, #90]
Edda: "Plain speaking, neighbors: I don't trust Isolde. Constance's reading pointed at them."  [case board: #91]
Isolde: "Please hear me gently, everyone—I only held back out of fear, but I am the Lamplighter."
Isolde: "The night before you arrived, walking the lamps, I counted 2 others out."
Isolde: "On the first night, walking the lamps, I counted 3 others out."
Isolde: "Last night, walking the lamps, I counted 1 other out."
Isolde: "It pains me to say this aloud, truly, yet I fear Constance. Jory's reading says the people living on the Square aren't all on one side, and they live there."  [case board: #92, #93, #94, #95, #96]
Constance: "For your consideration: Last night, I watched the Market: I saw Isolde pass by."
